title: God’s Word
ref: 2 Timothy 3:16-17; Matthew 7:24-27 (Building Your House on the Rock)

sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another: Thanksgiving and Requests
Sing a song of praise together
Review & Accountability
To whom did you tell Jesus’ story?
Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Prayer)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
Every time we meet together, we read from God’s Word. Today, we are going to learn why God’s Word is so important.
2 Timothy 3:16-17
Matthew 7:24-27 (Building Your House on the Rock)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
The Scriptures are from God.
God’s Word is given to us so we can be equipped to do His work.
If we do not obey God’s Word, we are as foolish as a man who builds his house on the sand.
When we obey God’s Word, we are building our life on a strong foundation.
If we build our life on God’s Word, we will not fall.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Commit to spend time reading or listening to God’s Word every day.
Start at Matthew 5:1-5, then answer the two questions we always ask:
What did I learn from this Scripture?
How will I obey what I have learned?
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God desires for every person in the world to repent of their sins. Let’s commit to preach the Gospel among all people.
Peter 3:9
Pray
Thank God for His Word and ask Him to help you understand His Word and obey it.
